KMB_2009_p17__paragraph_0.ocr:
(a)
The Corporation recorded an extraordinary charge of $12 million ($8 million after tax) related to the consolidation of its monetization
financing entities. See Item 8, Note 2 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

KMB_2009_p17__caption_1.ocr:
(b)
The Corporation’s share of net income includes a gain of approximately $46 million from the sale by Kimberly-Clark de Mexico, S.A.B.
de C.V. of its pulp and paper business.

KMB_2009_p17__paragraph_1.ocr:
(c)
The Corporation recorded a pretax asset retirement obligation of $24 million at December 31, 2005. The cumulative effect of accounting
change on income, net of related income tax effects, of recording the asset retirement obligation was $13 million, or $.03 per share.

KMB_2009_p17__paragraph_2.ocr:
(d)
Effective January 1, 2009, the Corporation adopted new accounting requirements with respect to the classification of noncontrolling
interests. Prior year results have been recast to conform to the current year presentation.

KMB_2009_p17__paragraph_3.ocr:
(e)
The Corporation’s basic and diluted earnings per share amounts for 2005 to 2008 have been recast to include certain share-based
payment awards as participating securities under the two-class method, as required by accounting requirements.
